WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(remaining) as overall_avg
  FROM budget
  WHERE remaining IS NOT NULL
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    event_status,
    AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining
  FROM budget
  WHERE remaining IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY event_status
)
SELECT 
  sa.event_status,
  sa.avg_remaining,
  sa.avg_remaining - oa.overall_avg as difference_from_overall
FROM status_averages sa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
